meaning: Finite source-derived candidates and explicit branch rules, not an already observed module set or a source/acceptance seal.
source_rule: For a source module actually present, require this exact release source hash at the corresponding installed Lib path, membership in the exact qualified inventory, and the concrete loader/cache/frozen rule. Extra candidates do not authorize their functions, callbacks or branch execution.

nonmodule_rule: Read only native module/type dictionaries with exact types and string keys. For the two named aliases use type.__getattribute__, not deprecated metaclass attribute hooks. No other non-ModuleType sys.modules value is admitted.
frozen_rule: Only these names/aliases, whose code is in the exact qualified Python ELF. Join canonical code filename and complete CodeType tree to compile of the pinned release source using the same frozen filename and optimize0. No generic frozen-name exception.
codecs_rule: The exact C.UTF-8/UTF8 JSON/ASCII HTTP/Latin1 header/API hostname path may resolve only these source-pinned codecs. IDNA brings the separately pinned stringprep/unicodedata path. A new codec/name is not silently added.
native_rule: A name being in sys.builtin_module_names alone is insufficient. Require this fixed native name, exact BuiltinImporter with qualified ELF attribution, or exact ExtensionFileLoader at a regular qualified-inventory ELF under the installed Python lib-dynload tree. No nonstdlib extension origin.
unresolved_dynamic_import_policy: Any reachable nonliteral import/callback not accounted for by the selected prefix table below makes source qualification NOT_ESTABLISHED. A later sys.modules/maps snapshot cannot repair a transient earlier execution.
